claims.text: The table in UPI OC 185B lists a cumulative limit of ₹10 Lakh for the Capital Market category but does not state that this figure sets the per-mandate ceiling for a single IPO.
claims.original_text: The table in UPI OC 185B (S1) lists a cumulative limit of ₹10 Lakh for the Capital Market category but does not state that this figure sets the per-mandate ceiling for a single IPO.

candidate.text: The 10 lakh cumulative limit for Capital Market transactions (MCC 6211) is established by NPCI/UPI/OC-185B, not OC-185A. This circular explicitly sets the enhanced per transaction limit at Rs. 5 lakh and the cumulative limit at Rs. 10 lakh for IPOs under MCC 6211.

findings.reason: The answer claims the 10 lakh figure is a cumulative limit that does not set a per-mandate ceiling (S1.1), yet it simultaneously asserts that NPCI/UPI/OC-127 explicitly enhanced the per-transaction limit to Rs 5 lakh for IPOs, separate from any cumulative table value (S2.1).
